title: New Heaven and New Earth
definition: The new heaven and new earth is the final renewed creation where God dwells with His redeemed people, sin and death are removed, and righteousness reigns forever.
summary: The Bible’s final hope is not escape from creation but renewal under God’s reign. God will wipe away every tear, and His people will dwell with Him in holiness and joy.
christFocus: Christ makes all things new. The story of redemption ends with God’s presence, the Lamb’s victory, and the complete restoration of His people and creation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Sin, death, mourning, and pain will be removed.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The Lamb is central to the eternal joy and worship of God’s people.
